measurement: warm page textures; two forward/reverse cycles; vsync-filtered FrameTiming
geometry: Per-result renderer: mesh row curl or analytic inverse row curl
limitations: Synthetic typography and PNG fixtures; real PDFium rendering of a simple generated PDF.
No production chapter layout, EPUB capture, CBZ extraction, disk I/O, selection or progress integration.
RGBA bytes exclude PDF/native/transient/cached GPU allocations; RSS is whole-process memory.
Pipeline budget exceedance is not measured dropped-frame rate or input-to-display latency.
No Apple Books side-by-side comparison; row curl is not a physical paper solver.
Shader uses an approximate vertical inverse, analytic shadows, and no mesh edge stroke. It is not pixel-equivalent to the mesh.
